# Zahin Syahiran - UI/UX Designer & Brand Strategist

> Zahin Syahiran is a Senior UI/UX Designer and Brand Strategist based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia (GMT+8). He specializes in UI/UX design, brand identity systems, design systems, and building AI-native web products.

## About & Experience
- **Current Position**: Senior UI/UX Designer at Gamuda Technologies (focusing on AI products).
- **Background**: ~8 years across graphic design, branding, and product design (including 5+ years in FinTech, InsurTech, and B2B SaaS).
- **Previous Roles**: MoneyX, Borong Malaysia, PolicyStreet, Fixcolab, Paperballad.
- **Ventures**: Founded Designloka in 2019 (Malaysia's first subscription-based graphic design service).
- **Education**: Honours degree in Graphic Design from Saito University College (2024).
- **Location**: Kuala Lumpur / Selangor, Malaysia (GMT+8). Available for hybrid/remote roles & select freelance projects.

## Services & Rates
- **Website Design & Development**: RM5,300 (Includes UI/UX design, Frontend dev, Google Antigravity, GEO setup, custom layout, up to 7 pages).
- **Brand Identity Package**: RM1,000 – RM3,000
- **Logo Design**: RM800 / design
- **Website Design (UI only)**: RM450 / page
- **Company Profile Design**: RM1,500 / 10 pages
- **Presentation / Pitch Deck Design**: RM1,300 / document
- **Social Media Design Visuals**: RM110 / visual
- **Brochure / Trifold Design**: RM350 / visual
- **Business Card Design**: RM150 / design
- **Packaging Design**: RM150 – RM350
- **Email Newsletter Design**: RM300 / visual

## Key Projects
- **Great Eastern Takaful**: Customer experience rearchitecture & website UX audit.
- **MoneyX App**: FinTech mobile app savings goals & user acquisition referral program UI/UX design.
- **PolicyStreet**: InsurTech car insurance marketplace platform.
- **Knock Knock Cafe**: Art direction, brand identity, packaging, and storefront design.
- **Medigo**: AI-powered medical tourism marketplace connecting patients with verified clinics across Malaysia.
- **Flaaah**: Brand creative direction as a core business strategy.
